净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Crossover preserves the primary synergy trend mechanism from the payoff-first parent (correlation-weighted blend of short and long trends) and borrows the range asymmetry ratio (down/up day average range) from the predictive-first parent. The asymmetry ratio amplifies the correlation weight when downside volatility dominates, reflecting the leverage effect where volume-price alignment is more info

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-(asym_ratio = (60) ts_mean(down range) / (60) ts_mean(up range); scale = 1 + 0.5*clip(asym_ratio-1, -0.2, 0.2); blend = clip(ewm_mean(span=3, clip(corr(roc(close,20), roc(volume,20), 20),0,1))1), span=3) * scale, 0, 1); factor = short_trend*blend + long_trend*(1-blend))
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

asym_ratio不对称比不对称比
blend混合混合
down下行下行方向的统称
factor因子输出因子输出
long_trend长期趋势长窗口趋势（如 20/80 日均线比）
range振幅high - low；当日价格区间
short_trend短期趋势短窗口趋势（如 20/40 日均线比）

算子

算子含义
ts_meants_mean(x, n) → 滚动均值
clipclip(x, lo, hi) → 裁剪到区间
ewm_meanewm_mean(x, span=n) → 指数加权移动平均 (EMA；span 控制衰减速度)
corrcorr(x, y, n) → 相关系数
rocroc(x, n) → n 期变动率

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 price_roc：close.pct_change(20)
  2. 计算 volume_roc：volume.pct_change(20)
  3. 计算 corr：price_roc.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).corr(volume_roc)
  4. 计算 smooth_corr：corr.ewm(span=3, adjust=False).mean().clip(0, 1)
  5. 计算 short_trend：(close.滚动窗口(10).mean() / close.滚动窗口(40).mean() - 1)
  6. 计算 long_trend：(close.滚动窗口(20).mean() / close.滚动窗口(80).mean() - 1)
  7. 计算 up：(close > close.shift(1)).astype(float)
  8. 计算 down：(close < close.shift(1)).astype(float)
  9. 计算 up_range：(range * up).滚动窗口(60).sum()
  10. 计算 up_count：up.滚动窗口(60).sum()
  11. 计算 down_range：(range * down).滚动窗口(60).sum()
  12. 计算 down_count：down.滚动窗口(60).sum()
  13. 计算 up_mean：up_range / up_count
  14. 计算 down_mean：down_range / down_count
  15. 计算 asym_ratio：down_mean / up_mean
  16. 计算 scaling：1 + 0.5 * np.clip(asym_ratio - 1, -0.2, 0.2)
  17. 计算 blend_weight：(smooth_corr * scaling).clip(0, 1)
  18. 计算 factor：short_trend * blend_weight + long_trend * (1 - blend_weight)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. rolling(60) — rolling(n) → 滚动窗口
  2. mean(down range) — mean(x, n) → 滚动均值
  3. rolling(60) — rolling(n) → 滚动窗口
  4. mean(up range) — mean(x, n) → 滚动均值
  5. clip(asym_ratio-1, -0.2, 0.2) — clip(x, lo, hi) → 裁剪到区间

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_asymmetry_volatility_synergy_trend(df): df_copy = df.copy() "com"># Primary mechanism "kw">class="kw">from parent 1: correlation-weighted trend synergy price_roc = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change(20) volume_roc = df_copy["str">'volume'].pct_change(20) corr = price_roc.rolling(20, min_periods=20).corr(volume_roc).fillna(0) smooth_corr = corr.ewm(span=3, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean().clip(0, 1) short_trend = (df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(10).mean() / df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(40).mean() - 1) long_trend = (df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(20).mean() / df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(80).mean() - 1) "com"># Lightweight modifier "kw">class="kw">from parent 2: range asymmetry (down/up day average range) df_copy["str">'range'] = df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low'] up = (df_copy["str">'close'] > df_copy["str">'close'].shift(1)).astype(float) down = (df_copy["str">'close'] < df_copy["str">'close'].shift(1)).astype(float) up_range = (df_copy["str">'range'] * up).rolling(60).sum() up_count = up.rolling(60).sum().replace(0, np.nan) down_range = (df_copy["str">'range'] * down).rolling(60).sum() down_count = down.rolling(60).sum().replace(0, np.nan) up_mean = up_range / up_count down_mean = down_range / down_count asym_ratio = down_mean / up_mean "com"># Bounded scaling factor "kw">class="kw">from asymmetry scaling = 1 + 0.5 * np.clip(asym_ratio - 1, -0.2, 0.2) blend_weight = (smooth_corr * scaling).clip(0, 1) factor = short_trend * blend_weight + long_trend * (1 - blend_weight) factor.name = "str">'factor_asymmetry_volatility_synergy_trend' "kw">class="kw">return factor
